intro: Trigonometry studies the relationship between the sides and angles of a right-angled triangle. For an acute angle A, the ratios of the sides (sin, cos, tan and their reciprocals) depend only on the angle, not on the size of the triangle.
keyPoints: sin A = opposite/hypotenuse, cos A = adjacent/hypotenuse, tan A = opposite/adjacent.
cosec A = 1/sin A, sec A = 1/cos A, cot A = 1/tan A.
tan A = sin A / cos A.

examples.title: Finding other ratios
examples.problem: If sin A = 3/4, find cos A and tan A.

examples.title: Proving an identity
examples.problem: Prove that (sec A + tan A)(1 − sin A) = cos A.
steps: LHS = (1/cos A + sin A/cos A)(1 − sin A)
= (1 − sin²A)/cos A = cos²A/cos A = cos A = RHS
